blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Bolivar Heights rose from 11 in June to 14 in October (+27.3%), and 2 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.0% of Surrey’s 1,434 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Bolivar Heights?

blocks.text: Bolivar Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

7 condos sold in Bolivar Heights with a median price of $460,000, taking a median of 26 days to sell at 95.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Bolivar Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 14 condos and townhomes listed in Bolivar Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Bolivar Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Bolivar Heights had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Bolivar Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 2 condos and townhomes sold in Bolivar Heights over those 5 months, out of 737 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Bolivar Heights sell for?
faq.a: 7 condos sold in Bolivar Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $460,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Bolivar Heights?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
